entries.zh: 一大块划归居住、商业及社区功能的舰船区段。它是我们迁徙文明涌动的核心。
entries.en: Vast sections of the ship given over to housing, commerce, and community. The living heart of a civilization in motion.

entries.zh: 在下部舰体整齐排列的一大组大功率反应堆，将澎湃的动力传输给舰上的每个系统。
entries.en: Banks of high-output reactors lining the lower hull, channeling raw power to every system aboard.

entries.zh: 方舟的这些甲板目前用于居住，但也可以发展出更多特化用途。
entries.en: These decks of the arkship are currently used for housing, but could be developed for more specialized purposes.

entries.zh: 这些装甲工程区段里居住着工程专家，负责维护方舟武备、防御系统和船体完整性。
entries.en: Armored engineering sections housing the specialists who maintain the Arkship's weapons, defense systems, and hull integrity.

entries.zh: 对驿站的远程管理是一项充满艰辛且永无止境的后勤工作，但总得有人来承担这项任务。
entries.en: The remote management of stations is a thankless task of endless logistic needs, but someone must handle it.

entries.zh: 宇航采收工负责轨道矿藏的收集和处理，大幅提升了资源产出。
entries.en: Astro-Harvesters facilitate the collection of orbital deposits and their processing, greatly increasing resource yield.

entries.zh: 专业的维护组会对导弹舱进行定期维护保养，确保其状态良好随时待发，他们以纯粹的能源消耗为代价换取了先发制人的打击能力。
entries.en: Dedicated maintenance crews keep the missile bays primed and ready, trading raw energy output for strike-first firepower.

entries.zh: 全天候生产动能弹药，确保我们的巨炮永不哑火。每一件装填器、每一个弹壳、每一份推进剂的用量都经过精确计算。
entries.en: Round-the-clock fabrication of kinetic rounds ensures the guns are never silent. Every loader, every casing, every gram of propellant is accounted for.

entries.zh: 一排排高容量电容直接向激光阵列灌输能量，在发射器散热能力的极限维持开火速率。
entries.en: Banks of high-cycle capacitors feed energy directly to the beam arrays, sustaining fire rates that would otherwise overheat the emitters.

entries.zh: 无间断的训练让我们可以用无与伦比的精度运作舰载机，编织起梯次火力。
entries.en: Continuous training lets us weave in battery fire with strike craft operations with unparalleled precision.
Increases the £strategic_resource£ ['concept_strategic_resources'] upkeep of the Arkship crew.

entries.zh: 引擎旁路系统摒弃了传统的冷却方式，转而将多余能量直接用于驱动舰船引擎，但这一做法的代价是能量币的产量随之降低。
entries.en: Instead of relying on traditional cooling methods, the Engine Bypass directly reuses excess energy to fuel the ship's engines, at the cost of reduced energy credit production.

entries.zh: 在反应堆中注入异星物质使我们能够维持超出正常指标参数的护盾。
entries.en: The injection of exotic materials in the reactors allows us to run shields beyond their normal parameters.

entries.zh: 在方舟上划分出专用空间，用于对采集到的资源进行分类与初筛，可以利用重力场下的操作优势与高效机械设备，从而提高资源产出。
entries.en: Reserving dedicated arkship space for the collection and triage of harvested resources offers a higher yield thanks to the opportunity of in-gravity operations and the use of more streamlined machinery.

entries.zh: 方舟上的水培农场将为我们的人民提供食物。
entries.en: Onboard hydroponic farms will grow the sustenance of our people.

entries.zh: 随着专业人员开始协调我们的驿站和定居国家市场之间的货物运输，商业在这些甲板间川流不息。
entries.en: Commerce flows through these decks as specialists coordinate the movement of goods between our Waystations and the markets of settled space.

entries.zh: 这是一个负责协调我们驿站与广阔市场之间货物流通的处理单元。效率是其唯一目标。
entries.en: A processing unit assigned to coordinate the flow of goods between our Waystations and the wider market. Efficiency is its only directive.

entries.zh: 宇航员配备的采收子个体，是专为执行太空行走任务而设计的，其主要职责是离开方舟，前往舱外采集轨道上的矿产资源。
entries.en: Astro-Harvester Drones are engineered for spacewalk operations, facilitating the collection of orbital deposits from outside of the Ark.

entries.zh: 聚星球于一舟，化一舟为星球。
entries.en: Our world became our ship and our ship became our world.

entries.zh: 将我们部分铸造厂改造为专门生产标准化装甲板的工厂，即可为我们提供随时可用的烧蚀防护备用件。
entries.en: Specializing part of our foundries to directly manufacture standardized armor plating gives us a ready supply of ablative protection replacement.

entries.zh: 将船舶建造和维护服务纳入我们的军事日程中，就能够调动部队支援海军造船厂。
entries.en: By introducing ship building and maintenance service in our military schedule, we can mobilize troops to assist our naval yards.

entries.zh: 一座专门研究高能物理的设施，部署在方舟舰的核心。
entries.en: A dedicated high-energy physics research facility tapping into the heart of the Arkship.

entries.zh: 研究人员借助这些定制实验室对方舟上的人口进行观察性研究。
entries.en: These bespoke laboratories are utilized by researchers conducting observational studies on the Arkship's population.

entries.zh: 我们的研究人员与负责方舟舰维护的人员之间的跨学科交流取得了实际成果。
entries.en: Cross-disciplinary communication between our researchers and those responsible for the maintenance of the Arkship yields practical results.

entries.zh: 游牧帝国的首都方舟承载着政府的行政中枢。那些引领舰队穿越星海的领袖们就居住于此。
entries.en: The Capital Arkship of a nomadic empire serves as the seat of government, its halls home to the leaders who guide the fleet across the stars.

entries.zh: 我们首都锻造厂的声浪，足以与引擎的轰鸣一较高下。
entries.en: The sound of our Capital's forges rivals the roar of our engines.

entries.zh: 工匠与工厂工人们忙碌的身影穿梭于首都的每层甲板，源源不断地为飞船注入动力。
entries.en: Every deck of our capital hums with the labor of artisans and factory workers, fueling our ship's needs.

entries.zh: 我们的首都是一座繁荣的商业枢纽，货舱中堆满了来自星系各地的货物。
entries.en: Our capital is a hub of commerce and prosperity, its holds filled with goods from across the stars.

entries.zh: 方舟的甲板层上住满了居民，其市场与大道上处处洋溢着商业与贸易的生机。
entries.en: The Arkship's decks are packed with residents, its markets and thoroughfares alive with commerce and trade.

entries.zh: 合金铸造厂的热浪辐射穿透了每一层甲板，工业机器有节奏的铿锵声在过道中回荡。
entries.en: The heat of alloy foundries radiates through every deck, the rhythmic clang of industry echoing along its corridors.

entries.zh: 整艘方舟专注于管理并统合子民。
entries.en: An entire Arkship dedicated to the administration and unification of our people.

entries.zh: 这艘方舟的实验室在科学研究与技术进步中处于领先地位。
entries.en: This Arkship's laboratories lead the way in scientific research and technological advancement.

entries.zh: 一排排的水培装置与生物质加工线，支撑着方舟上的人口度过星际间的漫长旅程。
entries.en: Rows of hydroponic arrays and bio-processing lines sustain the Arkship's population through the long journey between stars.

entries.zh: 近乎无穷无尽的反应堆核心阵列在这艘方舟各处嗡嗡作响、散发光芒，输出的能量供给着整个舰队。
entries.en: Near-endless arrays of reactor cores hum and glow throughout this Arkship, their output powering the fleet.

entries.zh: 这艘方舟遍布武器炮台，并加固了舱壁，堪称一座移动堡垒。
entries.en: Bristling with weapons emplacements and reinforced bulkheads, this Arkship is a fortress on the move.

entries.zh: 一个由维修机库与修复设施组成的网络贯穿这艘方舟的各层甲板，维持着整个舰队的正常运转。
entries.en: A network of servicing bays and repair facilities runs throughout this Arkship's decks, keeping the fleet operational.

entries.zh: 这艘方舟的每一层都满是熙熙攘攘的走廊与公共舱室，集体意志的嗡鸣声在其中回荡。
entries.en: Teeming corridors and communal chambers fill every level of this Arkship, humming with collective purpose.

entries.zh: 混合生产的重工业支配着这艘方舟的生产区域。
entries.en: Heavy industry with mixed production dominates this Arkship's manufacturing decks.

entries.zh: 一座悲悯的摇篮，其间的每一个有机体都得到了尊重，其走廊中保持着祥和的宁静。
entries.en: A cradle of compassion where all organic life is sacred, its corridors kept in peaceful silence.

entries.zh: 位于§Y[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系的方舟$SHIP|Y$已被摧毁。
entries.en: The Arkship, $SHIP|Y$ in the §Y[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed.

entries.zh: 我们成功摧毁了$SHIP|Y$号方舟。
我们位于§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系的方舟$SHIP|Y$已被摧毁。
entries.en: Our Arkship, $SHIP|Y$ in the §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed.

entries.zh: 反叛猎人追上了我们的$SHIP|Y$方舟。我们只能以货舱中的物资转移他们的注意力才得以逃脱。\n\n库存资源丢失：[ROOT.GetArkshipHunterLoot]
entries.en: The Usurper's hunters caught up to our Arkship $SHIP|Y$. We only managed to escape by distracting them with the contents of our hold.\n\nMissing from our stores:[ROOT.GetArkshipHunterLoot]

entries.zh: 我们的方舟舰$SHIP|Y$被瘫痪在了§Y$SYSTEM$§!。
entries.en: Our Arkship $SHIP|Y$ has been disabled in §Y$SYSTEM$§!.

entries.zh: 将舰船的工业中心与外围的物流基础设施结合在一起。
entries.en: Combines the industrial heart of the ship with its broader logistical infrastructure.

entries.zh: 很少有什么东西能像科普、通俗历史和全年龄向商品那样将人们团结起来。
entries.en: Few things unite people like pop-science, pop-history, and age-appropriate merchandise.

entries.zh: 对我们而言发现并不是一种个人成就，而是集体的官能之一。
entries.en: Discovery is not an individual achievement here. It is a function of the collective.

entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RWe are nomads. We can not form §YMigration Treaties§!§!

entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThey are nomads. They can not form §YMigration Treaties§!§!

entries.zh: 我们遭到了星际大炮的攻击
entries.en: We have been attacked with a Stellar Cannon

entries.zh: 有一座§R星际大炮§!正在锁定§Y$SYSTEM$§!。
entries.en: A §RStellar Cannon§! is taking aim at §Y$SYSTEM$§!.

entries.zh: £nomad£ §H$concept_nomadic_empires$§!是一种运作在可移动的£arkship£ ['concept_arkships']之上，而非扎根于固定的£colony£ ['concept_colonies']的文明。他们无法宣称£system£ ['concept_systems']或者殖民£planet£ ['concept_planets']。\n\n§H游牧帝国§!能修建£waystation£ ['concept_waystations']来收集资源，也可以接受£planet£ ['concept_settled_empires']发来的£contract£ ['concept_contracts']。
entries.en: £nomad£ §H$concept_nomadic_empires$§! are civilizations that operate from mobile £arkship£ ['concept_arkships'] rather than stationary £colony£ ['concept_colonies']. They do not claim £system£ ['concept_systems'] or colonize £planet£ ['concept_planets'].\n\n§HNomadic Empires§! can build £waystation£ ['concept_waystations'] to collect resources, and can accept £contract£ ['concept_contracts'] from £planet£ ['concept_settled_empires'].

entries.zh:
£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires']的§H$concept_operational_reserves$§!是£minerals£ ['concept_minerals']与£energy£ ['concept_energy']的综合展现。

£minerals£ §H$concept_minerals$§!和£energy£§H$concept_energy$§!仍有收入与支出，只是会以['concept_situation']的形式呈现。

每一点§H$concept_operational_reserves$§!等价于一点£minerals£ §H矿物§!或£energy£ §H能量币§!。

$nomad_max_reserves_breakdown$

局势的各个§H阶段§!将对帝国£arkship£ ['concept_arkships']的许多方面产生影响，你也可以选择不同§H应对方案§!来节约资源或者燃烧资源以提高生产力。

你可以从£market£ ['concept_market']中购买£minerals£ §H$concept_minerals$§!和£energy£ §H$concept_energy$§!，但无法售卖。
entries.en:
The §H$concept_operational_reserves$§! for £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires'] are a combined view of £minerals£['concept_minerals'] and £energy£ ['concept_energy'].

There is still income and upkeep of £minerals£ §H$concept_minerals$§! and £energy£ §H$concept_energy$§!, but managed as a ['concept_situation'].

One point of §H$concept_operational_reserves$§! is equal to one £minerals£ §HMineral§! or one £energy£ §HEnergy Credit§!.

$nomad_max_reserves_breakdown$

The §HStages§! of the situation affect the empire's £arkship£ ['concept_arkships'] in different ways, and §HApproaches§! can be selected to conserve resources or burn through them for higher productivity.

£minerals£ §H$concept_minerals$§! and £energy£ §H$concept_energy$§! can be bought on the £market£ ['concept_market'], but not sold.

entries.zh: £planet£ §H$concept_settled_empires$§!是指以£planet£ ['concept_planets']上固定的£colony£['concept_colonies']为根基进行统治的文明，他们能够宣称£system£ ['concept_systems']并利用['concept_starbases']进行防御。\n\n对于£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires']而言，§H定居帝国§!是潜在的£contract£ ['concept_contracts']与['concept_diplomatic_pacts']来源，不过当游牧舰队跨越定居帝国边境时也可能会引发外交摩擦。
entries.en: £planet£ §H$concept_settled_empires$§! are civilizations that govern from stationary £colony£ ['concept_colonies'] on £planet£ ['concept_planets'], claiming £system£ ['concept_systems'] and defending them with ['concept_starbases'].\n\nFrom the perspective of £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires'], §HSettled Empires§! are potential partners for £contract£ ['concept_contracts'] and ['concept_diplomatic_pacts'], though diplomatic friction may arise when nomadic fleets cross their borders.

entries.zh:
£contract£ §H$concept_contracts$§!既有由£planet£ ['concept_settled_empires']发布给£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires']的任务，也有§H$concept_nomadic_empire$§!自身内部提出的任务。

这些任务囊括了从突袭宿敌到运送外交官等一系列操作，通常只能由£arkship£ ['concept_arkships']来完成。

§H合约§!在£interface£ ['concept_situation_log_view']中的$situation_log_view_tab_situation_log$选项卡中列出。
entries.en:
£contract£ §H$concept_contracts$§! are tasks given to £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires'] by £planet£ ['concept_settled_empires'], or internal tasks from parts of the §H$concept_nomadic_empire$§! itself.

These tasks range from raiding rivals to transporting diplomats, and can typically only be completed by £arkship£ ['concept_arkships'].

§HContracts§! are listed in the $situation_log_view_tab_situation_log$ tab of the £interface£ ['concept_situation_log_view'].

entries.zh:
£waystation£ §H$concept_waystations$§!是一种空间站，由£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires']所建造，能够从天体收集资源，并建立星际贸易航路，也被称为£wayline£ ['concept_waylines']。

§H$concept_waystations$§!收集的资源被存储在§H驿站库存§!之中，等待着£construction_ship£ ['concept_logistic_ship']或者£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']前来提取。

即使没有§H恒星系所有者§!的允许，也可以在£system£ ['concept_systems']中建造§H$concept_waystations$§!，不过这会给恒星系所有者的外交带来负面影响，给予他们§H$war_goal_wg_expel_nomads$§!战争目标。签署['concept_wayline_pact']则可以移除这些负面惩罚。$DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$帝国所能维持的§H$concept_waystations$§!数量由['concept_starbase_capacity']所限制。
entries.en:
£waystation£ §H$concept_waystations$§! are space stations, built by £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires'], that can collect celestial resources and form interstellar trade routes, known as £wayline£ ['concept_waylines'].

Resources collected by §H$concept_waystations$§! are held in the §HWaystation Stockpile§! until visited by a £construction_ship£ ['concept_logistic_ship'] or £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'].

§H$concept_waystations$§! can be constructed in £system£ ['concept_systems'] without permission from the §HSystem Owner§!, which incurs Diplomatic Penalties with the System Owner, granting them the §H$war_goal_wg_expel_nomads$§! War Goal. Signing a ['concept_wayline_pact'] will remove these penalties. $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$The number of §H$concept_waystations$§! an empire can support is limited by its ['concept_starbase_capacity'].

entries.zh: £wayline£ §H$concept_waylines$§!是由相邻£system£ ['concept_systems']中的£waystation£ ['concept_waystations']建立的星际贸易航线。\n\n§H驿站模块§!会提供沿§H$concept_wayline$§!传播的效果与修正，这些效果也会通过与§H恒星系所有者§!签订的['concept_wayline_pacts']进行共享。例如，§H$sm_waystation_logistics_hub$§!能够收集整条£waystation£ §H$concept_wayline$§!沿线的所有§H$concept_waystations$§!存储的资源。
entries.en: £wayline£ §H$concept_waylines$§! are interstellar trade routes formed by £waystation£ ['concept_waystations'] in neighboring £system£ ['concept_systems'].\n\n§HWaystation Modules§! provide effects and modifiers that are propagated along the §H$concept_wayline$§! and shared by ['concept_wayline_pacts'] with the §HSystem Owner§!. For example, the §H$sm_waystation_logistics_hub$§! allows for the collection of stockpiled resources from all £waystation£ §H$concept_waystations$§! along an entire §H$concept_wayline$§!.

entries.zh: §H$concept_wayline_pacts$§!是一种由£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire']与另一个帝国所签订的['concept_diplomatic_pacts']。这些条约能让双方帝国从沿§H驿道§!传播的£wayline£ ['concept_wayline']§H修正§!中获益。\n\n此外，如果条约是在§H$concept_nomadic_empire$§!与£planet£ ['concept_settled_empire']之间签订的，那么§H驿道§!所产生的外交惩罚将消失。
entries.en: §H$concept_wayline_pacts$§! are ['concept_diplomatic_pacts'] signed between a £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire'] and another empire. These agreements allow both Empires to benefit from the £wayline£ ['concept_wayline'] §HModifiers§! propagated along the §HWayline§!.\n\nAdditionally, when signed between a §H$concept_nomadic_empire$§! and a £planet£ ['concept_settled_empire'], any Diplomatic Penalties caused by the §HWayline§! are ignored.

entries.en: A £construction_ship£ §H$concept_logistic_ship$§! can harvest resources from celestial bodies and transport them to our $arkship_cap_plural$.$tt_use$- ['scripted_action:logistic_harvest_resources'] from Planets, Moons and Asteroids$NEW_LINE$- Build £waystation£ ['concept_waystations'] in £system£ ['concept_systems'] to expand our £wayline£ ['concept_waylines']$NEW_LINE$- Build ['concept_megastructures'] $NEW_LINE$- Collect resources from £waystation£ §H$concept_waystations$§! $NEW_LINE$- Cannot build new £arkship£ ['concept_arkships'], which only other §HArkships§! can do $NEW_LINE$- Research certain ['concept_special_projects']$tt_gain$- Build §H$concept_logistic_ships$§! in an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship']

entries.zh: £arkship£ §H$concept_arkships$§!是载着£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires']穿越太空虚空的巨舰，可同时作为£colony£ ['concept_colony']、['concept_starbase']和['concept_military_ship']运作。$DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$—作为§H殖民地§!，其上包含£district£ ['concept_districts']、£zone£ ['concept_district_specializations']、£building£ ['concept_buildings']和£pop£ ['concept_pops']。$NEW_LINE$—作为§H恒星基地§!，它们可充当['concept_shipyards']，并可使用§H方舟舰模块§!和§H系统§!进行定制。$NEW_LINE$—§H$concept_arkships$§!的所有§H殖民地§!与§H恒星基地§!建造共享同一个建造队列。$NEW_LINE$—作为§H军用舰船§!，§H$concept_arkships$§!拥有多个机库与点防御，以及可观的装甲和护盾。$NEW_LINE$—§H$concept_arkships$§!可从£construction_ship£ ['concept_logistic_ships']和£waystation£ ['concept_waystations']处收集囤积的资源。$NEW_LINE$—§H$concept_arkships$§!还可执行更多战略行动，包括：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—['concept_survey']$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—['concept_megastructure', $BUILD_MEGASTRUCTURE_ORDER$]$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—['scripted_action:arkship_harvest_resources']$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—§H方舟舰模块§!可解锁更先进的行动。$NEW_LINE$—研究£engineering_research£ §Y$tech_arkship_construction$§!后，其他§H$concept_arkships$§!可将新的§H$concept_arkships$§!作为['concept_megastructures']建造。$NEW_LINE$—研究£engineering_research£ §Y$tech_arkship_tier_2$§!与£engineering_research£ §Y$tech_arkship_tier_3$§!后，§H$concept_arkships$§!可进行升级。
entries.en: £arkship£ §H$concept_arkships$§! are colossal vessels that carry £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empires'] through the void of space, functioning at once as a £colony£ ['concept_colony'], ['concept_starbase'], and ['concept_military_ship']. $DOUBLE_NEW_LINE$- As §HColonies§!, they contain £district£ ['concept_districts'], £zone£ ['concept_district_specializations'], £building£ ['concept_buildings'] and £pop£ ['concept_pops']. $NEW_LINE$- As §HStarbases§!, they act as ['concept_shipyards'] and can be customized with §HArkship Modules§! and §HSystems§!. $NEW_LINE$- §H$concept_arkships$§! have a shared build queue for all §HColony§! and §HStarbase§! construction. $NEW_LINE$- As §HMilitary Ships§!, §H$concept_arkships$§! boast multiple hangar bays and point-defenses, and significant armor and shields. $NEW_LINE$- §H$concept_arkships$§! can collect stockpiled resources from £construction_ship£ ['concept_logistic_ships'] and £waystation£ ['concept_waystations']. $NEW_LINE$- §H$concept_arkships$§! can perform additional strategic actions, including: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- ['concept_survey'] $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- ['concept_megastructure', $BUILD_MEGASTRUCTURE_ORDER$] $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- ['scripted_action:arkship_harvest_resources'] $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- §HArkship Modules§! unlock more advanced actions. $NEW_LINE$- New §H$concept_arkships$§! can be constructed as ['concept_megastructures'] by other §H$concept_arkships$§! after researching £engineering_research£ §Y$tech_arkship_construction$§!. $NEW_LINE$- §H$concept_arkships$§! can be upgraded after researching £engineering_research£ §Y$tech_arkship_tier_2$§! and £engineering_research£ §Y$tech_arkship_tier_3$§!.

entries.zh:
£settle£ §H$concept_arkship_settle$§!是指让£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']永久停驻在一颗星球上，结束游牧航行的行为。

需要完成['tradition_category:tradition_adaptability']或['tradition_category:tradition_versatility']传统树。

要进行§H$concept_arkship_settle$§!，需要选择一艘§H方舟舰§!，右键点击一颗未殖民['concept_habitable_world']或在£interface£ ['concept_colony_view']点击§H殖民§!按钮。

拥有更多§H方舟§!的帝国可以选择继续作为游牧帝国，并将新殖民的£planet£ ['concept_settled_empire']转变为一个['concept_subject']。

无主£system£ ['concept_systems']内的£waystation£ ['concept_waystations']将会转化为['concept_outposts']。
entries.en:
To £settle£ §H$concept_arkship_settle$§! is when a £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] permanently settles on a world, ending its nomadic voyage.

This requires that either the ['tradition_category:tradition_adaptability'] or ['tradition_category:tradition_versatility'] tradition tree has been completed.

To §H$concept_arkship_settle$§!, either select an §HArkship§! and right-click an uncolonized ['concept_habitable_world'] or click the §HColonize§! button in the £interface£ ['concept_colony_view'].

An empire with additional §HArkships§! can choose to let them continue as nomads and turn the newly £planet£ ['concept_settled_empire'] into a ['concept_subject'].

£waystation£ ['concept_waystations'] in unowned £system£ ['concept_systems'] are converted into ['concept_outposts'].

entries.zh:
£embark£ §H$concept_arkship_embark$§!是指让£planet£ ['concept_settled_empire']离开['concept_habitable_world']，登上一艘£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']变为一个£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire']的行为。

这需要完成['tradition_category:tradition_adaptability']或['tradition_category:tradition_versatility']传统树。

要进行§H登船§!，在一个£colony£ ['concept_colony']打开['concept_decisions']界面并选择§H$decision_nomad_embarkation$§!。

如果帝国拥有复数['concept_colonies']，可以选择将余下部分转变为一个['concept_subject']，或是将新形成的§H游牧帝国§!释放为一个§H$concept_subject$§!。

拥有的所有['concept_starbases']转化为£waystation£ ['concept_waystations']，而启程的行星变为§H$stripped_planet$§!。
entries.en:
To £embark£ §H$concept_arkship_embark$§! is when a £planet£ ['concept_settled_empire'] leaves their ['concept_habitable_world'] and boards an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] to become a £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire'].

This requires that either the ['tradition_category:tradition_adaptability'] or ['tradition_category:tradition_versatility'] tradition tree has been completed.

To §HEmbark§!, open the ['concept_decisions'] panel on a £colony£ ['concept_colony'] and select §H$decision_nomad_embarkation$§!.

If an empire has multiple ['concept_colonies'] they can choose to leave them behind as a ['concept_subject'], or instead release the new §HNomadic Empire§! as a §H$concept_subject$§!.

All owned ['concept_starbases'] are converted into £waystation£ ['concept_waystations'], and the embarked planet becomes a §H$stripped_planet$§!.

entries.zh:
庆祝我们的旅途：

在§R6§!个月的时间内均匀地耗尽运行储备，然后结束庆典。
entries.en:
Celebrate our Journey:

Spends our Operational Reserves evenly over §R6§! months, then the Festival ends.

entries.zh: 采取一切办法来庆祝这辉煌时刻
entries.en: Use everything we have for this glorious moment

entries.zh: 我们整个舰队正在勒紧裤腰带过日子。维护费用的降低减少了我们的能量和矿物成本，从而减缓了对运行储备的消耗。
entries.en: We are tightening expenditures across the fleet. Reduced upkeep lowers our Energy and Mineral costs, slowing the drain on our Operational Reserves.

entries.zh: 我们稳步前行，既不囤积也不耗尽资源。仅在必要时动用运行储备。
entries.en: We travel at a steady pace, neither hoarding nor exhausting our resources. Operational Reserves are spent only when required.

entries.zh: 我们全力驱动方舟舰，并对每一层甲板提出更高要求。专家产出的提升会增加能量与矿物开支，从而加速消耗我们的运作储备。
entries.en: We drive the Arkship hard and demand more from every deck. Greater Specialist output raises Energy and Mineral costs, burning through our Operational Reserves.

entries.zh: 我们的储备槽空空如也。在恢复之前，严重的经济处罚将使我们的研究和生产陷入瘫痪。
entries.en: Our reserve silos are all but empty. Severe economic penalties cripple our research and production until we recover.

entries.zh: 我们的储备日渐枯竭，只能四处寻觅基本必需品。
entries.en: Our reserves are running low. We can but forage for the bare essentials.

entries.zh: 我们的储备情况尚可。我们可以去追求更好的星星和更多的赏金。
entries.en: Our reserves are in decent shape. We can press for better stars and greater bounties

entries.zh: 我们的仓库几近填满，人们渴望新的冒险。
entries.en: Our silos are nearly full and our people are eager for new adventures

追寻愈发奇诡的星辰，我们因共同的流浪情怀而紧密相连。我们歌颂星海中的每一抹光亮，并珍视追逐遥远星辰的每一刻。
entries.en: Seeking ever stranger stars, we are united by our shared wanderlust. We celebrate ever light in the galaxy and cherish every moment chasing distant stars.

entries.zh: 可用的局势应对方案：['concept_nomad_festival']\n情报日志条目：['concept_journey_tracker']
追踪遍布星海的['concept_unique_encounters']。\n已经追踪到的发现物将提高['concept_nomad_festival']的效果。
entries.en: Tracks ['concept_unique_encounters'] throughout the galaxy.\nTracked encounters improve the effects of ['concept_nomad_festival'].

entries.zh: 独一无二的星辰，绚烂奇异的星系，斑斓诡谲的生物。
entries.en: Unique Stars, Unique Systems and Unique Creatures.

entries.zh: 在我们伟大的征程中，我们追踪所发现的每一颗恒星、每一个星系以及每一个新生命。
entries.en: In the course of our great journey, we track every star, system and new being we find.

entries.zh: 在旅行之中，我们记录发现的每一个星系，每一颗星球以及每一种新生命。\n繁星之典进度翻倍
entries.en: Throughout our travels, we record every solar system, planet and new beings we find.\nSpecial Journal Entries count double

entries.zh: 好奇的天性深埋于蜂巢的DNA之中。它追寻着一颗又一颗陌生的星辰，沉醉于繁星之中。
entries.en: Curiosity is written deep in this hive's DNA. It seeks ever stranger stars, and revels in the knowledge that there is always more out there to be found.

entries.zh: 这台机械智能的明确目的就是穿梭于虚空之中，记录一切事物。不要遗漏任何一颗星星，也不要遗漏任何一个生物。日志必须完整且实时更新。
entries.en: It is this Machine Intelligence's explicit purpose to traverse the void and record all things. Leave no star unsighted and no creature unlisted. The Journal must be complete and up to date.

entries.zh: 星系中最顶级的旅游运营商！这家公司以总能为其独家客户群提供新奇体验为荣。
entries.en: The finest tour operator in the galaxy! This corporation prides itself on always having something new to offer to their exclusive clientele.

entries.zh: 星系中最黑暗的宝石，闪烁着无限重力之光。
entries.en: The darkest jewels of the galaxy, ablaze with the fires of infinite gravity.

entries.zh: 文明的灯塔，照亮了无尽的虚空。
entries.en: Lighthouses of civilizations, brightening the endless void.

entries.zh: 有的星辰以激情陨落。余下的则以坚韧长存。
entries.en: Some stars die with passion. What remains does so with integrity.

entries.zh: 繁星之典：双星与三星系统
entries.en: Star Journal: Binary and Trinary Systems

entries.zh: 不是所有恒星都是独居的隐士，有些恒星渴望陪伴，哪怕彼此之间是撕裂的命运。
entries.en: Not all stars are solitary, some seek companionship so much they tear each other apart.

entries.zh: 在深空之中，有这样一群四处漫游的生物，它们轻而易举地跨越了生物学的边界，仿佛是神话中的造物。
entries.en: In the far depths of space, there roam creatures which ever so casually cross the border of biology into mythology.

entries.zh: 我们内心深处知道，外面有更多未知。
entries.en: Deep down, we know that there is more out there.

entries.zh: 进度取决于矿物和能量币收入。
entries.en: Progress depends on Mineral and Energy income.

entries.zh: 我们将与该帝国签订$wayline_pact$。这将给予他们在我方领土内建造驿站的权利，同时我们也能接入他们的驿道网络并从中获益。

entries.en: We are prepared to offer you the right to build Waystations within our territory. In exchange, we seek the benefits your Wayline network can provide.

entries.en: We accept. Perhaps one of our Waystations will find a home in your territory soon.

entries.zh: 你想要在我方星系中建造驿站吗？
entries.en: You wish to build Waystations in our systems?

entries.zh: 我们的舰队远道而来，希望您能批准我们在你们领土上建造驿站，作为回报，你们可以接入我方的驿道网络。
entries.en: Our fleets travel far. We seek the right to build Waystations within your territory, and offer access to our Wayline network in return.

entries.zh: 如您所愿，就按照你们自己的想法来建驿站吧。
entries.en: You are welcome to proceed. Build your Waystations as you see fit.

entries.zh: 我们不允许外国设施部署在我方领土。
entries.en: We will not permit foreign installations in our space.

entries.zh: 我们将与该帝国签订$wayline_pact$，并从驿道网络中共同受益。
entries.en: We will form a $wayline_pact$ with this Empire, allowing us to jointly benefit from one another's Wayline Networks.

entries.zh: 无法与该帝国分享驿道网络。
entries.en: Unable to share Wayline networks with this empire.
§H[Actor.GetName]§! proposes a mutual Wayline network sharing agreement.

entries.zh: 我方提出的共享驿道网络的提议被拒绝了。
entries.en: Our proposal to share Wayline networks was declined.

entries.zh: §H[Actor.GetName]§!拒绝了我方共享驿道网络的提议。
entries.en: §H[Actor.GetName]§! has declined our proposal to share Wayline networks.
§H[Actor.GetName]§! has agreed to share their Wayline network with us.

entries.zh: 他们是想要共享我们在驿站间建立的驿道吗？
entries.en: They wish to share the lines we establish between our Waystations?

entries.zh: 我们的舰队与大家共享这片虚空，拓展驿道，并藉由建造的设施获益，这似乎是很自然的。
entries.en: Our fleets jointly share the void. It seems only natural that we extend our Waylines to one another and benefit from what we have built.

entries.zh: 我们之间的道路应当畅通无阻。我方同意与你们共享驿道网络。
entries.en: The paths between us should be well-traveled. We agree to share our Wayline network with you.

entries.zh: 我们觉得把航道握在自己手中更好，就不和你们分享这套网络了。
entries.en: We prefer to maintain ownership of our routes. There will be no sharing of networks.

entries.zh: 撕毁与该帝国的$wayline_pact$，收回所有关联驿道网络的通行权。
entries.en: Revoke our $wayline_pact$ with this empire, ending all associated Wayline network access.

entries.zh: 他们已经撕毁了我们的$wayline_pact$。
原先设置的条款不再适合我们了，我们之间的$wayline_pact$就此解除，即刻生效。
entries.en: The terms of this arrangement no longer suit us. Effective immediately, the $wayline_pact$ between us is dissolved.

entries.zh: 我们没有收到预期的效果，条约即刻终止。
entries.en: We had expected otherwise. The arrangement is concluded.
We will form a $wayline_pact$ with the §H[Actor.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 提升驿站观测收集的社会学研究。
entries.en: Increases the Society Research gathered by our waystation observers.

entries.zh: 我们正加大对于洞见的投资，导致我们驿站观察员获取到的社会学研究点数减少。\n£society_research£ 前超光速文明产出的社会学研究：§R-2§!
entries.en: We are investing more into gaining Insights, reducing the Society Research gathered by our waystation observers.\n£society_research£ Society Research Collected from Pre-FTL Civilizations: §R-2§!

entries.zh: 我们正命令驿站观察员们最大化程度地收集数据，提高了他们的社会学研究产出。\n£society_research£ 前超光速文明产出的社会学研究：§G+2§!
entries.en: We are directing our waystation observers to maximize data collection, boosting the Society Research they produce.\n£society_research£ Society Research Collected from Pre-FTL Civilizations: §G+2§!

entries.zh: §H$ARKSHIP_LABEL$§!\n选择你初始方舟的类型并自定义名称。
entries.en: §H$ARKSHIP_LABEL$§!\nSelect the class of your initial arkship and customize its name.

entries.zh: 此设施将我们漂泊的舰队扎根于宇宙中的一个固定点位。借助锚定于此的驿站，我们指定此恒星系为§H$crisis_sphere_0$§!工程的天锚。我们在星海间收割的能量将汇聚于此，撕裂两界之间的屏障。
entries.en: This installation tethers our mobile fleet to a fixed point in the cosmos. By anchoring our Waystation here, we designate this system as the focal point for the §H$crisis_sphere_0$§! construction. The energies we harvest across the stars will converge here, tearing open the barrier between worlds.

entries.zh: 游牧帝国必须选定§H以太相锚定§!驿站模块的位置才能启动最终阶段。该驿站模块所处的恒星系将承载§H$crisis_sphere_0$§!。
entries.en: Nomadic empires must designate an §HAetherophasic Anchor§! Waystation module before initiating the final stage. Build this module on a Waystation to choose which system will host the §H$crisis_sphere_0$§!.

entries.zh: 有一艘§H方舟舰§!目前正在向该恒星系§Y定居§!。
entries.en: An §HArkship§! is currently §YSettling§! in this system.

entries.zh: 游牧舰队的力量来源于支撑它的驿站网络。控制驿站即可有效限制其行动能力。
entries.en: A nomadic fleet is only as strong as the waystation network that sustains it. Seize the stations, cripple their reach.

entries.zh:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
劫掠一座游牧驿站，窃取其中储备的资源并摧毁一个模块。

向该行动指派一名§Y线人§!即有概率夺取驿站。
entries.en:
$IF_SUCCESSFUL|E$
Raid a nomadic waystation, stealing its stockpiled resources and stripping a module.

Assigning an §YAsset§! to this operation might let us destroy or take over the station.

entries.zh: 目标帝国在探测范围内没有运转中的驿站。
entries.en: The target empire operates no waystations within sensor range.

entries.zh: 我方特工已经开始接近目标驿站，并绘制了安全模式图，确定了进入位置。我们已准备好推进至下一阶段。
entries.en: Our operatives have made their initial approach to the target waystation. Security patterns have been mapped and entry vectors identified. We are ready to move to the next phase.

entries.zh: 我们的特工现已渗透进驿站的船员、访客与系统之中。关键安全中继器已被禁用，内部通讯正通过我们自己的过滤器转发。这座空间站，已经是我们的囊中之物了。
entries.en: Our agents are now embedded within the waystation's crew, visitors and systems. Key security relays have been disabled and communications are being routed through our own filters. The station's fate is in our hands.

entries.zh: 我们的情报网络已经确定了一个目标驿站。特工已经渗透完成，准备就绪。增援部队随时待命，准备登上空间站。他们将按我们的指令发起突袭。
entries.en: Our intelligence network has pinpointed a target waystation. Our operatives are embedded and ready. Reinforcements are standing by to board the station. They will strike at our command.

entries.zh: 我方特工已消灭了§Y[target_waystation.GetName]§!上的安全部队，我们正在转移其资源。待行动完成后，他们将……
entries.en: Our operatives have neutralized the security forces aboard §Y[target_waystation.GetName]§!, and we are in the process of appropriating their resources. Once they are done, they will...

entries.zh: §Y[target_waystation.GetName]§!遭到了渗透！入侵者以武力强行夺取了空间站的控制权，并洗劫了库存的资源。
entries.en: The §Y[target_waystation.GetName]§! was infiltrated! The intruders used force to seize control of the station and appropriate its stockpiles.

entries.zh: 尽管袭击者采取了种种预防措施以隐匿身份，但我们还是查明他们隶属于 §Y[From.GetName]§!。他们必须要为此付出代价！
entries.en: Despite their precautions to stay anonymous, we have identified the attackers as belonging to the §Y[From.GetName]§!. They will pay for this!

entries.zh: 尽管我们尽了最大努力，但还是无法确认袭击者的真实身份。
entries.en: Despite our best efforts, we could not manage to identify the attackers.

entries.zh: 炸药引爆后，空间站被破坏，关键系统被摧毁，空间站的完整性受到损害。
entries.en: The station was then scuttled after explosive charges detonated, taking down critical systems and compromising the station's integrity.

entries.zh: 空间站局部在战斗中受损，但在部分敌人先行带着战利品离开后，我们的安全部队设法重新夺回了空间站。
entries.en: Part of the station was damaged during the fighting, but our security forces managed to regain control after part of the enemies left with their loot.

entries.zh: $nomads.8030.intro$现已查明，§Y[From.GetName]§!正是此次行动的幕后黑手——现在他们已经直接控制了该驿站，令其脱离了我们的驿道网络。
entries.en: $nomads.8030.intro$ It is now clear that the §Y[From.GetName]§! was behind this operation, as they have now assumed direct control of the waystation, effectively severing it from our wayline network.

entries.zh: 这艘方舟现在可以建设额外的§Y模块§!或§Y系统§!。
entries.en: This Arkship can support the construction of additional §YModules§! and/or §YSystems§!.

entries.zh: 这个驿站现在可以建设额外的§Y模块§!。
entries.en: This Waystation can support the construction of additional §YModules§!.

entries.zh: $SEPARATOR$\n§E该§H$SLOT_TYPE$§!未使用，可用于方舟的进一步升级改造。§!
entries.en: $SEPARATOR$\n§EThis §H$SLOT_TYPE$§! is empty and can be used to further develop the Arkship.§!

entries.zh: §R该§H$SLOT_TYPE$§!当前尚未解锁。§!\n$SEPARATOR$\n§E升级方舟舰解锁更多槽位。§!
entries.en: §RThis §H$SLOT_TYPE$§! is currently locked.§!\n$SEPARATOR$\n§EUnlock additional slots by upgrading the Arkship.§!

entries.zh: $SEPARATOR$\n§E该§H$SLOT_TYPE$§!未使用，可用于进一步发展驿站。§!
entries.en: $SEPARATOR$\n§EThis §H$SLOT_TYPE$§! is empty and can be used to further develop the Waystation.§!

entries.zh: §R这个§H$SLOT_TYPE$§!目前被锁定。§!\n$SEPARATOR$\n§E升级驿站以解锁更多槽位。§!
entries.en: §RThis §H$SLOT_TYPE$§! is currently locked.§!\n$SEPARATOR$\n§EUnlock additional slots by upgrading the Waystation.§!

entries.zh: 将§H驿站§!降级至前一等级？\n\n所有建筑和模块都将丢失。
entries.en: Downgrade the §HWaystation§! to the previous tier?\n\nAll buildings and modules will be lost.

entries.zh: $nomadic_system_initializer$一颗被星云遮蔽的棕矮星，周围环绕着由岩石与冰星构成的原始行星盘，这些天体仍在不断凝聚之中。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: $nomadic_system_initializer$A brown dwarf cloaked in a nebula, surrounded by a protoplanetary disk of rocky and icy bodies still coalescing.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$

entries.zh: $nomadic_system_initializer$超新星爆发后留下的致密残骸，周围环绕着被灼烧过的岩质世界与饱受辐射的碎片。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: $nomadic_system_initializer$The dense aftermath of a supernova, surrounded by scorched rocky worlds and irradiated debris.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$

entries.zh: $nomadic_system_initializer$一颗高亮度的蓝巨星，正以近乎自我毁灭的速度消耗着自身的燃料。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: $nomadic_system_initializer$An intensely luminous blue giant, consuming its fuel at a ruinous rate.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$

entries.zh: $nomadic_system_initializer$一颗明亮的蓝星与一颗中子星相伴而行，其外层物质被持续牵引剥离，化作喷薄而出的X射线辐射。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: $nomadic_system_initializer$A brilliant blue star paired with a neutron star companion, its outer layers steadily drawn away into a cascade of X-ray radiation.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$

entries.zh: $nomadic_system_initializer$一个恒星级黑洞，周围环绕着其前身恒星的残骸，高度辐射的岩石世界与漂泊的小行星带在其周围运行。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: $nomadic_system_initializer$A stellar-mass black hole surrounded by the remnants of its progenitor star, orbited by heavily irradiated rocky worlds and drifting asteroid fields.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$

entries.zh: $nomadic_system_initializer$两颗炽热的蓝星在相近的轨道上紧密缠绕，它们一起释放的辐射将近处的一切摧毁。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: $nomadic_system_initializer$Two blazing blue stars in close orbit, their combined radiation stripping the inner system bare.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
